task.title: Disable group access
task.shortdesc: You can disable group access to services by removing roles from a group. Because the roles and their permissions determine the type of access granted to the group, removing roles disables group access for that role.

ul.li: You are logged in to the Red Hat Hybrid Cloud ConsoleRed Hat Hybrid Cloud Console as a user who has Organization Administrator permission. You cannot log in to the Hybrid Cloud Console with your email address unless your email address is the same as your Red Hat login. For more information, see .
If you are not an Organization Administrator, you must be a member of a group that has the User Access administrator role assigned to it.

prereq.note: Groups can contain no roles and no members and still be a valid group.

step.cmd: Navigate to the Red Hat Hybrid Cloud Console > Settings > Identity & Access Management > User Access > GroupsRed Hat Hybrid Cloud Console > Settings > Identity & Access Management > User Access > Groups. The Groups page is displayed.
Click the Group Name that you want to modify.
Click the check box next to roles Name that you want to remove.

info.p: You can click the check box at the top of the Name column to select all roles.

step.cmd: Click the more options menu icon img more options that is next to the Add role tab, and then click Remove from group.
In the confirmation window that appears, click either Remove role or Cancel to complete the action.
